title_zh: 審查大型語言模型向不同對象建議的心理健康介入
title_en: Curbside chatbots: auditing mental health interventions LLMs recommend to clinicians, caregivers and patients
summary_zh: Beth Israel Deaconess 醫學中心數位精神病學部團隊審查 41 個語言模型在同一臨床資訊下，分別向臨床人員、照顧者及求助者本人建議的心理健康介入。研究以 19 個個案小品收集 35,055 則回覆，發現模型的建議會因對象身份而異，臨床人員多獲諮詢式回覆，一般用家則獲較簡化及帶保留的建議。
summary_en: A team from Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center's Division of Digital Psychiatry audited what 41 language models recommend when the same clinical information reaches them from a clinician, a caregiver, or the person themselves. Across 19 case vignettes and 35,055 responses, recommendations differed by footing: clinicians more often received consultation-style replies, while lay users received simpler, hedged advice.
caution: 預印本，未經同行評審；審查結果反映模型輸出模式，不等於臨床建議的正確性。
